title: NYAYAANUMANA and INLEGALLLAMA: The Largest Indian Legal Judgment Prediction Dataset and Specialized Language Model for Enhanced Decision Analysis
reasoning: The paper focuses on legal judgment prediction (LJP) and the generation of rationale explanations using a domain-specific LLM. While it contains an Ethics Statement regarding data anonymization and societal impact, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks as a primary research goal.
